title: Goats Drop Mutton
description: Goats now drop mutton and a 30% chance for wool, just to help out mountain survivors.
body:
# Gaots Drop Mutton

A simple but useful Minecraft datapack that makes goats drop mutton and wool, because let's be honest - they should have dropped these from the start!

---

## Features

- **Mutton Drops** - Goats now drop 1-3 mutton when killed (just like sheep!)
- **Wool Drops** - 30% chance to drop 1-2 white wool
- **Looting Compatible** - Get more mutton with the Looting enchantment
- **Lightweight** - Pure datapack modification, no code changes needed
- **Vanilla-Friendly** - Works perfectly in multiplayer and with other mods

---

## Why This Mod?

Goats in vanilla Minecraft only drop goat horns, which makes them pretty useless as a farm animal. This mod fixes that by making them a viable source of food and wool, similar to sheep. 

**Now your mountain goat farms actually have a purpose!**

---

## Drop Rates

| Item | Chance | Amount | Notes |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| Mutton | 100% | 1-3 | Becomes cooked mutton if killed by fire |
| White Wool | 30% | 1-2 | - |

> **Note:** Looting enchantment increases mutton drops by 0-1 per level

---

## Compatibility

### Works With
- Other farming mods
- Loot table mods
- Datapack-based mods
- Vanilla clients (when installed server-side only)

---

## Known Issues

None! This is a simple loot table modification, so it's very stable.

---

> If you enjoy this mod, please leave a rating and consider checking out my other projects!
